title: Fed Chairman Seeks to Calm Concerns About Elevated Inflation
summary: In a high-profile speech, Kevin M. Warsh said that the Federal Reserve was chiefly responsible for taming inflation. If price increases did not return to the central bank’s target quickly, “we have work to do,” he said.
